lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p25 - Listen and count.

details: Listen and count introduces the auditory sequence of numbers 30–40. Students listen to the track and track the numbers to learn the correct pronunciation and order.
Look for accurate tracking of the numbers with a finger and clear choral repetition of "thirty, thirty-one..." etc.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p25 - Count and write.

details: Count and write develops place value understanding. Students count the base-10 blocks (towers of ten and single cubes) to determine the total and write the digits.
Look for correct counting of the tens towers (10, 20, 30) followed by the ones, and writing the correct number (e.g., 33) on the line.

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p25 - Say the chant.

details: Say the chant reinforces the number sequence through rhythm. Students chant the numbers 30–40 to build fluency and memorisation.
Look for enthusiastic participation and staying in time with the rhythm while saying the difficult "th" sound in "thirty".

lessonPlan.topic: Numbers Book p91 - Add or take away.

details: Add or take away introduces calculation using visual support. Students use the number line to 'jump' forward (add) or backward (take away) to solve the sums.
Look for correct use of the number line (using a finger to hop) and writing the correct answers (32, 36, 36, 38).

lessonPlan.topic: Numbers Book p92 - Add and colour.

details: Add and colour combines calculation with art. Students solve the addition problems in the picture sections and use the key to choose the correct colour.
Look for correct answers to the sums (e.g., 30+1 = 31) and selecting the correct colour (e.g., 31 = Blue) to colour the teacher and classroom.
